methodology_note: SERP overlap was measured at two levels: exact-URL overlap and root-domain overlap across top organic results. Exact-URL overlap in this niche is abnormally low (max 2 of 10 on any pair), because the Indonesian UMKM marketing SERP is highly fragmented across low-authority publishers with little URL reuse across query variants. Clustering therefore uses domain-level overlap plus entity/intent overlap as the primary grouping signal, with URL overlap retained as the cannibalization signal. Where URL overlap is 0-1, the pages cannot cannibalize each other, which is reported as a positive finding rather than a reason to un-cluster.

cannibalization_findings.detail: Three articles all function as a general 'social media for UMKM' guide at 666-704 words each. None is long enough to act as a pillar, and together they split topical signal three ways for the same head term. SERP evidence shows K1 x K2 shares 2 URLs, confirming Google treats kelola-sosmed and strategi-konten as near-equivalent queries.
cannibalization_findings.fix: Promote sosial-media-marketing-untuk-umkm-panduan-lengkap to a 3200-word pillar. Re-angle kelola-sosmed to an explicit beginner workflow ('minggu pertama') and strategi-konten to a pure tactics listicle. Both must link up to the pillar with the pillar's exact anchor.

cannibalization_findings.detail: Two H2s on the same page cover target audience: '1. Kenali target audiens sebelum bikin konten' and '4. Tentukan target audiens yang presisi, bukan asal luas'. This also duplicates the dedicated spoke cara-menentukan-target-pasar-untuk-konten-media-sosial.

cannibalization_findings.detail: kelola-sosmed H2 #2 ('Bikin persona bisnis yang jelas sebelum posting') duplicates the persona section of the target-pasar spoke.
Zero shared URLs despite 3 shared domains. Google treats branding UMKM and personal branding UMKM as distinct queries. Safe to keep as two assets.

internal_link_findings.root_cause: The five articles published 2026-09-09 have a static 'Baca Juga' block that was never updated when the five 2026-09-11 articles shipped. Link flow is strictly one-directional from new to old. Every article carries exactly 3 outbound article links, hard-coded, with no reciprocity.
structural_issues: Every internal href uses the .html extension (/blog/foo.html) while canonical tags and sitemap.xml use the extensionless form (/blog/foo). With cleanUrls:true in vercel.json, every single internal link resolves through a 308 redirect before landing on the canonical URL. No internal link currently points directly at a canonical URL.
og:url includes .html (per recent commits) while rel=canonical does not, sending contradictory canonical signals to crawlers and social scrapers.
No breadcrumb markup on any article.
The homepage links to only 3 of 10 articles, all from the older batch.
Outbound links are confined to a 'Baca Juga' footer block. There are no in-body contextual links, which are worth substantially more than boilerplate blocks.

serp_intent_mismatches.detail: The SERP is dominated by volume listicles: majoo '50+ contoh', kumparan '100 contoh', liputan6 '200', '350', '350', '350'. Larisi's article contains 4 examples in 729 words. Format expectation is unmet by roughly two orders of magnitude. It cannot rank as written regardless of link equity.
serp_intent_mismatches.fix: Rebuild as 40-60 categorized, copy-pasteable examples segmented by vertical (fashion, kuliner, jasa, kecantikan) and by objective (diskon, produk baru, testimoni, restock). Keep the existing 4-principle framework as the intro, then deliver the volume the SERP requires.

serp_intent_mismatches.fix: Add a day-by-day WIB hour table and a per-niche table (kuliner, fashion, jasa, kecantikan). Add 'Instagram Insights' walkthrough. Add year to title.
